dict.string: Orbit shows today's agenda from your calendars. Events are read on this Mac only, never changed, saved or sent anywhere.
Only if you click Show Devices: Orbit lists your paired Bluetooth devices and lets you connect or disconnect them. Nothing is sent anywhere.
Only when you ask: for local weather (rounded coordinates go to Open-Meteo, nothing else) and because macOS requires it to show Wi-Fi network names. Wi-Fi names never leave this Mac.
